title: Mobility Equipment Retail Restocking Schedule — Chairs with Warranty Repair Jobs
content:
# Restocking Percentage on a Cash-Sale Chair Given Back — Mobility Equipment

**Schedule rule.** On a Mobility Equipment chair sold for cash and given back, the restocking percentage withheld depends on the repair jobs posted on the chair under the manufacturer's warranty: with 4 or more such jobs no restocking is withheld; with exactly 3 the restocking percentage is 5 percent; with exactly 2 it is 10 percent; with fewer the class's own restocking fee percentage applies unchanged. The restocking percentage acts on the price on the sale line alone.

## Jobs counted

Every repair job in the chair's service history whose cost is borne by the manufacturer's warranty, whatever the component (battery set, joystick and controller, motor and gearbox, tires and casters, or any other). Repairs paid by the patient or billed to a payer are not counted.

## Schedule

| Warranty repair jobs posted on the chair | Restocking percentage |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | the class's own restocking fee percentage |
| exactly 2 | 10 percent |
| exactly 3 | 5 percent |
| 4 or more | none withheld |

## Hypothetical illustrations (sale line price 3995.00)

- 2 warranty jobs: 10 percent of 3995.00, that is 399.50, is withheld from the price.
- 3 warranty jobs: 5 percent, that is 199.75.
- 4 warranty jobs: nothing is withheld for restocking.
